title: STATICK Cyber Systems
brief: Three self-contained, Spanish-language portfolio artboard alternatives for a software, cybersecurity, and education profile. Uses existing source-backed content only; no external assets or network requests.

artboards.title: Systems Editorial
artboards.tradeoff: Recommended: asymmetric, recruiter-first cinematic hierarchy with selected evidence; less dense than an index.

artboards.title: Research Index
artboards.tradeoff: Evidence-first, compact record layout for comparison; reduced emotional pull and visual drama.

artboards.title: Human Signal
artboards.tradeoff: Identity and contact-led approach; less immediate capacity for broad evidence comparison.
